---
title: "OSCC cytokine study: TPM export for CIBERSORTx"
output: html_document
---

Construct a gene-symbol TPM matrix for the 103 study samples from StringTie
gene-abundance tables. The expression filter matches the differential
expression analysis. Output includes the combined matrix and separate matrices
for IL-10 group codes 1 and 2. Deconvolution is performed externally.

The input directory must contain one `<sample_id>_gene_abund.tab` per sample
with `Gene.ID` and `TPM` columns after R's column-name conversion.
Missing genes and duplicate symbols are not automatically imputed or aggregated.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r inputs}
tpm_dir <- "mapped" # edit to your existing abundance folder
countData_ref <- read.csv("gene_counts_103_samples.csv", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  separate(gene_id, c("ensembl", "gene_symbol"), sep = "\\|",
           extra = "merge", fill = "right")
countData <- countData_ref %>% column_to_rownames("ensembl") %>%
  dplyr::select(-gene_symbol)
colData_cytokine <- read.csv("cytokineRNAseq.csv", row.names = "sample_id")
stopifnot(all(colnames(countData) %in% rownames(colData_cytokine)))
colData_cytokine <- colData_cytokine[colnames(countData), , drop = FALSE]
colData_cytokine$id <- rownames(colData_cytokine)
gene_ID <- rownames(countData)[rowSums(countData >= 10) >= round(ncol(countData)*0.9)]
files <- list.files(tpm_dir, pattern = "_gene_abund\\.tab$",
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
sample_names <- sub("_gene_abund\\.tab$", "", basename(files))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sample_names),
          all(colData_cytokine$id %in% sample_names))
files <- files[match(colData_cytokine$id, sample_names)]
sample_names <- colData_cytokine$id
dir.create("results/TPM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r tpm-matrix}
tpm_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(gene_ID), ncol = length(files),
                  dimnames = list(gene_ID, sample_names))
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  x <- read.table(files[i], header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "")
  idx <- match(gene_ID, x$Gene.ID)
  tpm_mat[, i] <- x$TPM[idx]
}
# Missing gene values and duplicated symbols are reported without imputation
# or aggregation.
if (anyNA(tpm_mat)) warning("Missing gene/TPM matches; resolve before uploading.")
tpm_103 <- as.data.frame(tpm_mat)
tpm_103$ensembl <- rownames(tpm_103)
tpm_103 <- tpm_103 %>%
  left_join(countData_ref %>% dplyr::select(ensembl, gene_symbol), by = "ensembl") %>%
  relocate(ensembl, gene_symbol, .before = 1) %>% dplyr::select(-ensembl)
if (anyNA(tpm_103$gene_symbol) || anyDuplicated(tpm_103$gene_symbol)) {
  warning("Missing or duplicated gene symbols in the deconvolution input.")
}
write.table(tpm_103, "results/TPM/TPM_matrix_for_CIBERSORT_103samples.txt",
             sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r il10-group-exports}
s1 <- colData_cytokine %>% filter(IL10_roc == 1) %>% pull(id)
s2 <- colData_cytokine %>% filter(IL10_roc == 2) %>% pull(id)
expr_1 <- tpm_103 %>% dplyr::select(gene_symbol, all_of(s1))
expr_2 <- tpm_103 %>% dplyr::select(gene_symbol, all_of(s2))
write.table(expr_1, "results/TPM/IL10_group1.txt", sep = "\t",
             quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(expr_2, "results/TPM/IL10_group2.txt", sep = "\t",
             quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
